kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

lines.say: Good morning. Got a lot on your plate today? Hand it over first.
lines.small: Got a lot on your plate today? Hand it over first.

lines.say: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established. Proverbs sixteen, verse three.
lines.big: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.

lines.say: Give him the work before you start it, and your mind gets steady.
lines.big: Give him the work before you start it, and your mind gets steady.

lines.say: Lord, I'm handing you everything I have to do today. Settle my thoughts. In Jesus' name, amen.
